name: 73701 · Enid, OK
findings: ZIP 73701 (Enid) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73701 (Enid) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
68% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73701 (Enid) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.
